summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on clarifying requirements for campaign planning and reporting features. It was decided that filters are prioritized over packages in the planner view. Regarding optimization methods, this section is currently a placeholder.

For metrics within the planner, only audience size (total traffic) can be calculated at present; other metrics are not yet accounted for.

In the campaigns list reports, initial graphics will not be implemented immediately. Instead, it was decided that the display should show traffic data specific to company dates, followed by a page structure similar to the existing traffic view, including demographics, dwell time, and frequency. A separate tab is also needed to display target audience metrics for each company.
decisions: Filters are prioritized over packages in the planner view.
Campaign reports will initially display traffic data by company dates, followed by standard views (demographics, dwell time, frequency).
A separate tab must be created to show target audience metrics for each company.
action_items: Follow up on the implementation of the campaigns list reporting features starting Monday.
